items.title: Cofounder of British fashion brand Superdry sentenced to 8 years in prison for rape
items.description: James Holder, 54, was found guilty by a jury in Gloucester Crown Court in the west of England last week of one count of rape but acquitted of a separate charge of assault by penetration in the May 2022 assault.

items.title: SBI board to consider up to $2 billion fundraising plan on 12 May
items.description: SBI's board panel to consider overseas fundraising plan of up to $2 billion through foreign currency bonds during FY27

items.title: Avi Polymers to acquire 90% stake in JVTR Consultants at Rs 500 crore valuation
items.description: The company plans to focus on areas such as information technology services, software development, system integration, digital platforms and related technology solutions, Avi Polymers Managing Director Chintan Yashwantbhai Patel said

items.title: Dabur raises prices by 4%, cuts packs sizes to handle rising input costs
items.description: To mitigate rising input costs due to the West Asia war, the company will be resorting to pricing actions. Meanwhile, the maker of Real fruit juice hopes to see double-digit growth in beverages category helped by El Nino impact

items.title: Emami acquires Vedix, SkinCraft parent for Rs 321 crore
items.description: Emami strengthens portfolio with 60% stake in Vedix and SkinCraft parent IncNut Digital

items.title: Tata, JSW conglomerates to plow $1 billion in EV, battery tech to reduce dependence on China: Report
items.description: Tata’s battery unit, Agratas Ltd., is spending more than $400 million on a new R&D facility in Bengaluru focused on developing lithium iron phosphate, or LFP, and lithium manganese iron phosphate technologies

items.title: Beverage, cola makers remain hopeful of strong season, despite western disturbances
items.description: Beverage and cola makers remain hopeful about a strong summer season, despite unseasonal rains as fundamental demand remains strong and an El Nino phenomenon makes their offerings more attractive.

items.title: CG Power eyes more semiconductor startup investments, expands AI design play
items.description: Speaking during the company’s Q4 FY26 earnings call, Managing Director and CEO Amar Kaul said the company is actively evaluating a pipeline of semiconductor design opportunities and acquisitions to strengthen its technology stack through subsidiary Axiro.
